name: Poulan Pro PRCS16i
blurb: Oregon's fit guide, one row under PRCS16I: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .043″ gauge, 56 drive links (Oregon R56).
intro: The Poulan Pro PRCS16i is the model Oregon prints as PRCS16I. In Oregon's saw-chain selection guide that name sits on its own line, followed by one chain: R56, 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints R56 directly under PRCS16i: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size or a Poulan part number for this row.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide, Poulan / Poulan Pro section: one chain row printed directly under the model

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), Poulan / Poulan Pro section, read 5 Nov 2026. Only models with a single chain row printed directly under the model name are listed. Models that share a block of several chain lengths are not given a page here.
